unit_tests.new_cases: Pending titles for greetings and partial hypotheses; explicit topic; evidence-backed analysis title; stability and manual override

checks: Transcript scroll viewport spans the complete window rather than a fixed region between toolbars
Last content and copy action clear the floating composer
Incoming live text preserves the reading position
Pending, automatic and manual titles persist across reopening
Legacy keyword titles appear as Desconocido unless a supported topic or manual name is available
Partial transcription status survives reopening without becoming a confirmed topic
Existing folders, sources, questions and keyboard interactions remain usable

design: Continuous reading background behind floating header and composer
Soft top and bottom transitions instead of hard rectangular clipping
Copy action moves with the transcript
Existing navy, violet and green colors retained

naming.confirmation: Final explicit topic announcement, or a model title supported by a source-backed passage of at least 200 characters and 35 words with at least two matching subject terms
naming.stability: A confirmed automatic name is retained; manual names take precedence
naming.limits: Conservative heuristics, not a calibrated semantic confidence score; ASR or model errors can still require renaming

privacy.test_content: Fictional transcript and isolated test databases
